name: [UPD 3] HITBLOX
desc:
Every contract has a clean way out.

HitBlox is a first-person stealth game. You're a hired assassin, and every contract drops you somewhere full of people who must never find out why you're there. How you do the job is up to you. Steal a disguise and walk right past the guards, set up an accident nobody will question, or wait for the perfect moment. Then slip away before anyone notices.

Stay unseen to earn the Ghost rank. Get spotted and things get loud.

Play alone, or team up with friends as a crew.

Earn cash, unlock new gear and guns, and dress your agent your way.

llm.loop: take a contract -> infiltrate a crowded location -> use disguises, staged accidents or timing to eliminate the target -> escape unseen -> earn cash and rank -> unlock gear, guns and outfits
llm.objectives: complete assassination contracts cleanly, ideally earning the Ghost rank
llm.progression: cash, new gear and guns, cosmetic cases, mission ranks
llm.instructions: steal disguises, set up accidents or wait for the moment, slip away; play solo or as a crew
unique: Hitman-style social stealth assassination on Roblox
llm.thumbnails: suited agent in mission locations (boardwalk, pool party, museum) with taglines 'Plan the hit. Walk out clean.', 'Wear any disguise', 'Make it look like an accident'
llm.complexity_notes: multiple handcrafted mission maps, NPC routine and detection AI, disguise and accident systems
